versions.content: The job of the function NvM_WritePRAMBlock shall skip writing and consider the job as successfully finished if the NvMBlockUseCRCCompMechanism attribute of the NVRAM Block is set t o true and the RAM block CRC calculated by the write job is equal to the CRC calculated during the last successful read or write job. This mechanism shall not be applied to blocks for which a loss of redundancy has been detected.
